identity.name: Furnace Toad
identity.summary: A squat brick red toad with a broad charcoal back.
identity.description: Deals 6 physical damage per affordable activation. Applies 4 burn through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
identity.lore: The kiln keeper mistook its first egg for a warm brick.
